description:
Omakey turns your iPhone into a real keyboard and touchpad for a Linux desktop running Omarchy (or a Steam Deck with SteamOS).

Every touch becomes a key press on a kernel-level virtual keyboard on the computer, so everything works as with a hardware keyboard: Hyprland shortcuts, Super + Space, F-keys, Esc, the lock screen, games and terminals.

A REAL KEYBOARD
• Ten layouts, from a classic QWERTY to split boards like Corne, Lily58 and Kinesis, plus Omakey Pro, made for two thumbs on a phone.
• Hold any chord with as many fingers as you like: Ctrl + Shift + T, Super + 4.
• Fn layers, sticky modifiers (tap Shift, Ctrl, Alt or Super for the next key), and the computer's Caps Lock light.
• Import your own layouts from the Omakey layout studio by link or file, and share them.

A TOUCHPAD
• Pull it down over the keys: one finger moves the pointer, tap to click, hold for a right click, two fingers scroll.
• Left, right, Ctrl-click and Shift-click buttons down both sides, scroll strips, and a pointer speed for each of your monitors.

PORTRAIT MODE
• Hold the phone upright and type with the iPhone keyboard, autocorrect and all, with the touchpad above it and strips of F-keys, arrows and shortcuts.
• English and Ukrainian text arrive as typed, whatever layout the computer is on.

SHARED CLIPBOARD
• Copy on the computer, paste on the phone, and the other way round.

FAST AND PRIVATE
• One encrypted packet per key press over your Wi-Fi, typically a few milliseconds.
• Pairing is a QR code shown on your computer; every packet is encrypted and authenticated with a 256-bit key that never leaves your phone.
• Omakey collects no data. There are no accounts, no servers and no analytics.

WHAT YOU NEED
On the computer, the free, open-source Omakey plugin for Omarchy (or the Steam Deck installer): see gladimdim.github.io/omakey-omarchy-plugin. No computer at hand? Try the demo computer built into the app.
promotionalText: Your iPhone becomes a real keyboard and touchpad for your Omarchy desktop: every key, every chord, Hyprland shortcuts and all, over Wi-Fi.
